voice.caption: At dawn Polyphemus opens the cave and feels every animal's back as it passes.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus binds three rams abreast for each man, suspending a sailor beneath the middle animal.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: I took the great lead ram myself and hung beneath his belly, my hands twisted in that miracle of wool, and dared not breathe. Over my head the blind master mourned to him: Sweet ram, why last from the cave today, you who were always first — do you grieve for your master's eye?
Outside, the men release themselves, drive the flock to the ship, and row away.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus divide the animals and sacrifice the great ram to Zeus.
